 '    <button class="clear wide" data-testid="key-clear">AC</button>\n    <button class="clear" data-testid="key-sign" aria-label="change sign">±</button>\n'),
("  // derived: true when entry came from ± or % on a computed number rather than typing;",

("  // [REQ-004]\n  // ± and % act on the current entry. With no entry in progress, the number on",

("  // [REQ-004]\n  function inputPercent() {\n    var n = state.entry === null ? state.value : Number(state.entry);\n    state.entry = String(n / 100);\n    state.derived = true;\n  }\n\n",""),
("  // [REQ-001] [REQ-003] [REQ-004] [REQ-005]\n  function press(key) {",
 "  // [REQ-001] [REQ-003] [REQ-004] [REQ-005] [REQ-006] The % key was removed.\n  function press(key) {"),

content.text:
I took the `%` key off the keypad and made AC two keys wide so the row stays full. The `%` shortcut on the physical keyboard is also gone, so percent can't be done another way. `±` still works. I haven't opened the page in a browser to check it.

Rules DEC-006 and DEC-007 still mention percent. DEC-007 no longer applies, and DEC-006 now covers only `±`.

Rejected: keeping the `%` keyboard shortcut, and making `%` mean "percent of the other number".
